caption.text:
60 SQL queries to crack any data interview 🧠

Stop re-reading theory. Start typing queries. This set takes you from your first SELECT to the window-function and CTE questions interviewers love, all on one PostgreSQL schema (employees, departments, orders).

Here's what the 60 drills cover, in order:

1️⃣ The practice schema and sample rows
2️⃣ Basics: selecting and shaping rows
3️⃣ Filtering with WHERE
4️⃣ Aggregates, GROUP BY and HAVING
5️⃣ Joins across tables
6️⃣ Subqueries
7️⃣ Window functions
8️⃣ CTEs and recursive queries
9️⃣ Real interview scenarios
🔟 A one-page SQL drills cheatsheet

Every task comes with the solution code and the exact result it returns on the sample data, so you can check your answer line by line.

Save this for your next interview prep session and send it to the friend who keeps saying "I'll learn SQL next week."

Comment “sql” to get every query and answer as a PDF.
